text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Tokyo Daishoten—the last and biggest dirt race of the year. Oguri Cap and Super Creek have come to watch Inari One's performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One sets off to take her place at the top of the regionals under the scrutinizing eyes of the two racers who turned heads at the Arima Kinen.
